/* Editorial engineering workspace: warm canvas, ink, muted sage and restrained cobalt */
:root{font-family:Inter,ui-sans-serif,system-ui,-apple-system,sans-serif;color:#252b2b;background:#f7f6f2;color-scheme:light}
body{background:#f7f6f2}
.app{background:#f7f6f2}
.bar{background:#fbfaf7;border-bottom:1px solid #e4e3dd;padding:15px 25px}
.brand{font-family:Georgia,'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:19px;letter-spacing:-.35px;color:#263b36;font-weight:700}
.sub{color:#7b817c;font-size:11px;margin-top:3px}
button{background:#fff;color:#39443f;border:1px solid #dedfd8;border-radius:10px;padding:9px 13px;font-size:12px;font-weight:600;transition:background .15s,border-color .15s}
button:hover{background:#f1f3ed;border-color:#b9c9bd}
button:focus-visible,input:focus-visible,textarea:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #8aa99a;outline-offset:2px}
.primary{background:#315d4b;border-color:#315d4b;color:#fff;box-shadow:0 2px 6px #315d4b1b}
.primary:hover{background:#244a3a;border-color:#244a3a}
.hero{background:#f7f6f2;border-bottom:1px solid #e6e5df;padding:20px 27px 18px}
.hero h1{font-family:Georgia,'Times New Roman',serif;color:#253a32;font-size:clamp(21px,2.4vw,29px);letter-spacing:-.8px;font-weight:500;margin-bottom:6px}
.hero p{color:#737d77;font-size:12px}
.workspace{background:#f7f6f2;padding:12px 17px 14px;gap:10px}
.top{gap:0;border:1px solid #e4e5df;border-radius:15px;overflow:hidden;background:#fff;box-shadow:0 6px 25px #2d40330a}
.pane{background:#fff}
.panehead{background:#fff;color:#33443b;border-bottom:1px solid #e9eae5;padding:12px 17px;font-size:12px}
.codepane{border-right:0}
.splitter{width:5px;background:#f0f0eb;cursor:col-resize;border-left:1px solid #e9eae5;border-right:1px solid #e9eae5}
.editor{background:#f9faf7;color:#355b50;padding:19px;font-size:12px;line-height:1.75}
.output{background:#fff;padding:18px 20px}
.muted{color:#89918b}
.tabbar{background:#fff;border-bottom:1px solid #e9eae5;padding:8px 14px;gap:6px}
.tabbar button{background:transparent;border:1px solid transparent;color:#77817a;border-radius:8px;font-size:12px;padding:8px 15px}
.tabbar button.active{background:#eaf0e9;border-color:#eaf0e9;color:#315d4b}
.tabbar button:hover{background:#f4f5f1}
.upload{background:#f3f6f1;border:1px dashed #bdcdbf;border-radius:13px;padding:18px;margin:0 0 19px}
.upload h3{font-family:Georgia,serif;font-weight:500;font-size:18px;color:#315444}
.upload input[type=file]{background:transparent;border:0;padding:7px 0;color:#526459}
.hint{color:#7b8b7f;font-size:12px;line-height:1.6}
.review{background:#fff;border:1px solid #e1e8df;border-radius:10px;color:#33443b}
.review pre{color:#496355}
.inputgrid{gap:12px}
label{color:#717b72;font-size:11px;font-weight:600;margin-bottom:7px}
input{background:#fbfcfa;color:#293b31;border:1px solid #dfe4dc;border-radius:9px;padding:10px}
input:focus{border-color:#84aa92}
.panel{border:1px solid #e6e9e3;border-radius:12px;padding:15px;margin:15px 0;background:#fff}
.panel h3{font-family:Georgia,serif;color:#344c3e;font-size:17px;font-weight:500}
.results{gap:11px}
.metric{background:#f5f7f2;border:1px solid #e8ede4;border-radius:11px;padding:14px}
.metric strong{color:#315d4b;font-size:19px}
.metric small{color:#7d8c7e}
table{color:#37483d;font-size:12px}
th{color:#6f7d71;background:#f8faf6}
td,th{border-bottom:1px solid #e9eee7;padding:10px 8px}
.pill{background:#e8f1e7;color:#47735a;border-radius:100px}
.terminal{background:#253a32;border:0;border-radius:13px;overflow:hidden;height:164px;box-shadow:0 4px 16px #2d403314}
.terminal .panehead{background:#2d453a;color:#f4f4ec;border-bottom:1px solid #446052}
.terminal .panehead button{background:#405b4d;color:#fff;border-color:#587363}
.terminal pre{color:#d7e8d8;padding:15px 18px}
.terminal.short{height:43px}
.tutor{background:#fff}
.chatlog{background:#fbfcf9;padding:20px}
.chatmsg{border:1px solid #e4e9e0;background:#fff;color:#35483b;border-radius:14px;padding:14px 16px;line-height:1.7}
.chatmsg.user{background:#e7efe7;border-color:#d7e5d7;color:#294b38}
.chatcompose{background:#fff;border-top:1px solid #e9eae5;padding:14px}
.chatcompose textarea{background:#fbfcfa;color:#33483c;border:1px solid #dce4da;border-radius:11px}
.suggestions{padding:14px;background:#fff;border-bottom:1px solid #eff0ea}
.suggestions button{background:#f7f9f5;border-color:#e7ece3;color:#4c6553}
svg{background:#f5f7f3}
.warning{color:#b27032}
@media(max-width:750px){.bar{padding:13px 15px}.hero{padding:17px 16px}.workspace{padding:9px;gap:9px}.top{border-radius:12px}.codepane{border-bottom:1px solid #e6e9e3}.terminal{min-height:150px}.output{padding:14px}.inputgrid{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}.controls{gap:5px}.controls button{padding:7px 9px;font-size:11px}}

# CEG 410 Structural Analysis Studio

A browser-based **JavaScript-only** 2D truss analysis tool for the CEG 410 group assignment.

## Run locally
Open `index.html` in a browser. For the source-code panel to load, serve the folder using `npx serve .` or another static server. No Python is needed.

## Interface
- **Top left:** actual read-only `solver.js` source code.
- **Right:** structural diagram, adjustable material/load inputs, computed forces, reactions and displacements.
- **Bottom:** collapsible execution log showing solver stages. This is an in-app solver log, **not a system shell**.
- The vertical divider is draggable on desktop.

## Engineering implementation
Uses the **matrix displacement method** for a linear-elastic, small-displacement, planar pin-jointed truss. For each member, the solver assembles the 4×4 global stiffness contribution using direction cosines, applies displacement boundary conditions, solves `K_ff u_f = F_f` using Gaussian elimination with partial pivoting, recovers reactions `R = Ku - F`, and recovers axial forces `N = (EA/L)[-c,-s,c,s]u_e`. Positive member force is tension; negative is compression.

**Units:** E in GPa, A in mm², load in kN, geometry in metres, output displacement in mm.

**Scope:** This initial version contains a fixed four-node, five-member example with adjustable E, A and load. It is not yet a general 1000-member truss modeller, slope-deflection solver, or member design checker. Those require separate implementation and verification. Results must be independently checked before engineering use.

## Verify
Run `node test.js` using Node.js. The tests check equilibrium and symmetry for the example.
